name: EmptyState
label: Empty state
description: The placeholder for a list, table, or search with nothing to show: icon, headline, guidance, and a next action.

props.name: icon
props.description: Material Symbol icon name, or a custom element (e.g. an illustration)

props.name: title
props.description:
Short headline describing the empty condition.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which EmptyState does not expose.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy — say what to do next, not just what is missing

props.name: action
props.description: Action slot — typically one primary Button, optionally a secondary

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual treatment. `plain` sits directly on the page; `bordered` draws a
dashed container, which reads better inside a card, table, or panel.
